lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: White spots are arranged in a regular grid of horizontal rows and vertical columns. Posterior to the gill slits, spots are small and high-density, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced circular nodes along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pale bands intersect with horizontal rows of white spots, forming a distinct checkerboard pattern in the mid-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow transition on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five remoras are visible in a cluster near the ventral-pectoral junction.
